sq.ANSWER:
Upto the stepMarks

\(\text{Fourier cosine transform: } F_c(s) = \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \int_{0}^{\infty} f(x) \cos(s x) dx\)

(2 Mark)

\(\text{Inverse cosine: } f(x) = \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \int_{0}^{\infty} F_c(s) \cos(s x) ds\)

(2 Mark)

\(\text{Fourier sine transform: } F_s(s) = \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \int_{0}^{\infty} f(x) \sin(s x) dx\)

(2 Mark)

\(\text{Inverse sine: } f(x) = \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \int_{0}^{\infty} F_s(s) \sin(s x) ds\)

(2 Mark)
sq.QUESTION_DESC: \(\text{Define Fourier cosine and sine transforms and their inverses.}\)

sq.ANSWER:
Upto the stepMarks

\(\text{Property: } F_c[f(x)\cos(ax)] = \frac{1}{2}[F_c(s+a) + F_c(s-a)]\)

(2 Mark)

\(\text{Proof: } F_c[f(x)\cos(ax)] = \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \int_{0}^{\infty} f(x) \cos(ax) \cos(sx) dx\)

(2 Mark)

\(= \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \cdot \frac{1}{2} \int_{0}^{\infty} f(x) [\cos((s+a)x) + \cos((s-a)x)] dx\)

(2 Mark)

\(= \frac{1}{2} \left[ \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \int_{0}^{\infty} f(x) \cos((s+a)x) dx + \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \int_{0}^{\infty} f(x) \cos((s-a)x) dx \right]\)

(2 Mark)

\(= \frac{1}{2}[F_c(s+a) + F_c(s-a)]\)
sq.QUESTION_DESC: \(\text{State and prove the modulation property for Fourier cosine transform.}\)

lq.ANSWER:
StepMarks
Fourier cosine transform: \(F_c(s) = \mathcal{F}_c\{f(x)\} = \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \int_{0}^{\infty} f(x) \cos(sx) dx\)(3)
Fourier sine transform: \(F_s(s) = \mathcal{F}_s\{f(x)\} = \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \int_{0}^{\infty} f(x) \sin(sx) dx\)(3)
Both transforms are defined for functions on \((0, \infty)\)(2)
Inverse formulas: \(f(x) = \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \int_{0}^{\infty} F_c(s) \cos(sx) ds\) and \(f(x) = \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \int_{0}^{\infty} F_s(s) \sin(sx) ds\)(2)
lq.QUESTION_DESC: \(\text{Define Fourier cosine transform and Fourier sine transform of a function } f(x).\)

lq.ANSWER:
StepMarks
For Fourier cosine transform: \(\mathcal{F}_c\{af(x) + bg(x)\} = a\mathcal{F}_c\{f(x)\} + b\mathcal{F}_c\{g(x)\}\)(3)
For Fourier sine transform: \(\mathcal{F}_s\{af(x) + bg(x)\} = a\mathcal{F}_s\{f(x)\} + b\mathcal{F}_s\{g(x)\}\)(3)
Proof for cosine: \(\mathcal{F}_c\{af(x)+bg(x)\} = \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \int_{0}^{\infty} [af(x)+bg(x)] \cos(sx) dx\)(2)
\(= a\sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \int_{0}^{\infty} f(x) \cos(sx) dx + b\sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \int_{0}^{\infty} g(x) \cos(sx) dx\)(2)
\(= aF_c(s) + bG_c(s)\)(2)
